monitoring_threshold_calibration.concern: 10 events older than 30s could be a normal burst (3 kiosk borne stress C8 scenario already shows 742 backlog accumulating in single dev session)
monitoring_threshold_calibration.recommendation: For Le Cayenne V1 density (1 branch, ~200-400 orders/day), threshold=10 is reasonable. For V2 multi-branch SaaS, switch discriminator to `oldest_pending_age_seconds > 300` (5 min) rather than count — count-based threshold drowns alerts during legitimate bursts (lunch rush 12:00-13:30).

queue_supervisor_resilience.what_if_redis_fills_under_allkeys_lru: Critical observation: cache and queue share Redis with maxmemory 1.5gb + allkeys-lru. Queue lists (`queues:high`, `queues:default`) ARE eligible for LRU eviction — silent job loss possible if cache traffic + queue depth jointly exceed 1.5 GB. Mitigation: queue keys are continuously read by `block_for: null` workers, keeping them HOT in LRU. But during prolonged worker outage, queue keys age and become evictable.
queue_supervisor_resilience.recommendation: P1 — split queue Redis from cache Redis OR change maxmemory-policy to `volatile-lru` (only evict keys with explicit TTL — queue list keys have no TTL by default in Laravel Redis driver, would never evict)
queue_supervisor_resilience.evidence: deploy/ansible/site.yml:79-91 sets maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru on the single Redis instance

eviction_policy_recommendation.issue: Risk of evicting queue list keys (no TTL) during cache spike — silent job loss
eviction_policy_recommendation.option_A: Split queue Redis (db=2) from cache Redis (db=1) using separate REDIS_DB env vars + separate maxmemory per logical DB
eviction_policy_recommendation.option_B: Switch to volatile-lru (only evict keys with TTL). Risk: cache keys without TTL (`forever`) would never evict either. Mitigation: enforce TTL on all Cache::put() via static analysis sentinel.
eviction_policy_recommendation.recommendation: P1 for V2 SaaS multi-host density. P3 for V1 LOCAL single-branch (1.5 GB headroom dwarfs actual usage).

production_monitoring_recommendations_to.title: Disk free <20% alert + df pre-check before mysqldump
production_monitoring_recommendations_to.rationale: Backup script catches truncation after the fact via gunzip -t but wastes 5-30 min mysqldump compute when disk is full. A 50-line df pre-check skips gracefully + alerts via existing BACKUP_ALERT_WEBHOOK.
production_monitoring_recommendations_to.implementation: scripts/backup-foodking-daily.sh: add at line 42 `available_kb=$(df --output=avail $LOCAL_DIR | tail -1); [[ $available_kb -lt $((2*1024*1024)) ]] && fail "insufficient disk: ${available_kb}KB free, need 2GB"`

production_monitoring_recommendations_to.title: Outbox monitor threshold — switch to age-based not count-based
production_monitoring_recommendations_to.rationale: Current `--threshold=10 stale 30s` produces false positives during legitimate lunch-rush bursts. `--max-age-seconds=300` (oldest pending >5min) is the right discriminator for pipeline-down vs busy-pipeline.
production_monitoring_recommendations_to.implementation: Add `--max-age-seconds=300` option to foodking:outbox:monitor + return FAILURE when oldest pending > max-age (instead of OR combined with count). Threshold becomes a soft-warn, age is the hard-alert.
production_monitoring_recommendations_to.priority: P2 for V1 (count works for 1 branch). P1 for V2 multi-branch.
production_monitoring_recommendations_to.production_signal: supervisor cron exit code → existing pager

production_monitoring_recommendations_to.title: schedule:run cron logging — pipe to storage/logs/schedule.log
production_monitoring_recommendations_to.rationale: Currently /dev/null — cron-level failures (e.g. supervisor crash, schedule:run crash, foodking:outbox:rescue not registered) are invisible. logrotate pattern already covers *.log glob so adding the file is free.

production_monitoring_recommendations_to.title: Redis memory >80% of maxmemory alert + INFO memory cron
production_monitoring_recommendations_to.rationale: allkeys-lru means silent eviction — queue list keys ARE eligible. Without an alert, the only signal is downstream symptom (lost broadcasts → Echo silent failure). Add a 5-min cron sampling `redis-cli INFO memory used_memory` and alert when >80% maxmemory (1.2 GB threshold for current 1.5 GB).
production_monitoring_recommendations_to.implementation: New artisan command `foodking:redis:memory-monitor --threshold=80` scheduled every 5 min; OR external node_exporter scrape if Prometheus is wired (cloud-prep backlog).
production_monitoring_recommendations_to.priority: P1 for V2 SaaS (high-density). P3 for V1 LOCAL (15x over-provisioned).

production_monitoring_recommendations_to.title: Queue worker liveness — verify numprocs=2 RUNNING
production_monitoring_recommendations_to.rationale: Supervisor restarts the worker after --max-jobs=1000 OR after crash, but if BOTH workers are in fatal+restart loop (e.g. broken composer.lock after deploy), there's no signal except outbox staleness (which fires AFTER the queue is already backed up).
production_monitoring_recommendations_to.implementation: Cron every 5 min: `supervisorctl status foodking-queue | grep RUNNING | wc -l` — alert if <2. Bonus: scrape into a Prometheus gauge.
